Moduli of an LWE ciphertext

Source: R/binfhe-keys.R
get_pt_modulus.Rd

get_modulus() of an LWECiphertext is its ciphertext modulus, and get_pt_modulus() its plaintext modulus. set_modulus() and set_pt_modulus() change the values recorded in the ciphertext, in place; they do not rescale it.

Usage

get_pt_modulus(ct)

set_modulus(ct, modulus)

set_pt_modulus(ct, plaintext_modulus)

Arguments

ct

An LWECiphertext.

modulus, plaintext_modulus

The new value: a whole number of at most 2^53, or a string of decimal digits.

Value

get_pt_modulus(): a number, or a string of decimal digits if the value is above 2^53. The setters: ct, invisibly.

Details

get_modulus() and get_length() also work on an LWEPrivateKey and an LWEPublicKey, and == and != compare two LWE ciphertexts, two secret keys or two public keys by content.
